annotations.title: Shunting-Yard Algebraic Math, Financial IRR/NPV & Descriptive Stats Solver

description: Strict Shunting-Yard AST arithmetic parser with zero eval() or dynamic code execution: evaluates algebraic formulas and computes exact financial NPV, Newton-Raphson IRR, Kelly criterion, and dataset stats. Use when computing exact arithmetic formulas, cashflow NPV/IRR, or descriptive statistics without LLM floating-point guesswork; for running two-sample A/B hypothesis tests, use evaluate_ab_statistical_significance instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'math_formula' ('precision_digits' defaults to '2_decimals'), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

expression.description: Algebraic or scientific formula to evaluate (e.g. '(125000 * (1 + 0.0725/12)^60) - 98450.50').

precision_digits.description: Decimal rounding precision for returned numbers; defaults to '8_decimals' when omitted.

name: evaluate_deterministic_math

dataset_statistics.description: Optional count, mean, median, std_dev, min, and max when a dataset array is supplied.

exact_result.description: Deterministic floating-point result of the expression.

financial_analysis.description: Optional NPV, Newton-Raphson IRR, and Kelly fraction when financial parameters are supplied.

title: Shunting-Yard Algebraic Math, Financial IRR/NPV & Descriptive Stats Solver
